selection: first 12 SHA-256(seed + canonical source id), searchable Korean rules excluding all 210-case targets
rules: Counterpart English documents and attachments remain in the same source group.
Keep all reserved documents in the retrieval corpus.
Do not use reserved query labels for development or lexicon changes.
Write and audit questions only after implementation is frozen; report one final run.
If the final result influences a subsequent change, mark that holdout consumed.

question_protocol.english_counterpart_queries: one supported question for each available reserved English counterpart
question_protocol.article_selection: stable SHA-256(seed + source id + owning article id); main searchable body before addenda, excluding deleted articles; take the first two distinct eligible articles
question_protocol.query_style: one explicit document/procedure question and one natural paraphrase per source; do not copy answer values into questions
question_protocol.negative_controls: new out-of-domain combinations; do not reuse Mars, driving licence or the existing evaluation sentences
question_protocol.ambiguity_controls: questions with multiple applicable reserved scopes; record the source evidence separately from expected clarification
question_protocol.timing: article selection and label writing start only after the implementation and experimental choices are frozen; do not tune after the final run
